description: Frontend API caching with TanStack Query - Replace direct axios calls with React Query for automatic caching, request deduplication, background refetching, and optimistic updates. Implement in custom hooks (useLeads, useJobs, useStats) and key pages.
steps: Run npm install in frontend/ directory
Create frontend/src/services/queryClient.ts with QueryClient configuration (staleTime: 5 minutes, cacheTime: 10 minutes, retry: 2)
Wrap App component in frontend/src/main.tsx with QueryClientProvider and add ReactQueryDevtools in development mode
Refactor frontend/src/hooks/useLeads.ts to use useQuery for fetching leads list and useMutation for create/update/delete operations with automatic cache invalidation
Refactor frontend/src/hooks/useJobs.ts to use useQuery with 10-second refetch interval for active jobs, remove manual setInterval logic
Refactor frontend/src/hooks/useStats.ts to use useQuery with 30-second staleTime
Update frontend/src/pages/Discovery.tsx to use React Query for live scan streaming (convert to useQuery with refetchInterval)
Update frontend/src/pages/DealsPipeline.tsx to use useMutation for drag-and-drop updates with optimistic updates
Create frontend/src/hooks/useCompanies.ts, useContacts.ts, useDeals.ts following the same React Query pattern
Add error boundaries in frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx to catch query errors gracefully
Test all pages: Verify network tab shows deduplicated requests, verify cache persists across page navigation
acceptance_criteria: useLeads, useJobs, useStats hooks refactored to use useQuery/useMutation
Network tab shows deduplicated API requests (same endpoint not called twice simultaneously)
Cache persists: Navigate from Leads → Dashboard → Leads shows instant load from cache
Background refetch works: Jobs page auto-updates every 10 seconds without manual interval
Optimistic updates work: Deal drag-and-drop shows immediate UI update before API confirmation
React Query DevTools visible in development mode (bottom-right corner)
No TypeScript errors in any refactored files
verification: cd frontend && npm install (installs react-query successfully)
npm run dev (frontend starts without errors)
Open http://localhost:5173 and check bottom-right for React Query DevTools icon
Navigate to Leads page, open Network tab, verify single /api/v1/leads request
Navigate away and back to Leads, verify instant load (no new request in Network tab)
On Jobs page, verify auto-refresh every 10 seconds in Network tab
On Pipeline page, drag a deal, verify optimistic update (card moves immediately)
No console errors in browser DevTools
